bibl.title: Revisiting the First Monastery of Apa Phoibammon. A Prosopography and Relative Chronology of Its Connections to the Monastery of Apa Ezekiel within the Monastic Network of Hermonthis during the 6th Century.
bibl.seg: Frederic Krueger, Revisiting the First Monastery of Apa Phoibammon. A Prosopography and Relative Chronology of Its Connections to the Monastery of Apa Ezekiel within the Monastic Network of Hermonthis during the 6th Century.
bibl.note: 1. Introduction. - 2. The main contact: Andrew of Hermonthis and the Monastery of Apa Ezekiel. - 3. The 6th century prosopography of the First Monastery of Phoibammon. - 4. The end of an era: Abraham's correspondence with John during the transition from Hermonthis to Thebes. - Appendix: Comments and Berichtigungen to the rock inscriptions and ostraca (O.Mon.Phoib.) from the First Monastery of Apa Phoibammon.
